description: Bybit cold wallet hack, Ethereum mainnet, 2025-02-21. SafeTx structure as stated in public post-mortems; not reconstructed from chain data.
safeTxHashNote: Safe 1.1.1 domain is EIP712Domain(address verifyingContract) without chainId; our SafeTx hash (>= 1.3.0 domain) differs by design. The hash and nonce come only from Safe's transaction service record.
whatItDid: data decodes to transfer(0xbDd077f651EBe7f7b3cE16fe5F2b025BE2969516, 0); the 0x9622... contract's transfer writes _to into storage slot 0, so under DELEGATECALL it overwrote the Safe proxy's masterCopy with 0xbDd0..., which has sweepETH/sweepERC20.
signatures: The signers signed the bare safeTxHash (ETH_SIGN, v = 0x1f) according to Safe's transaction service record.
disagreements: Check Point names 0xbdd0... as the delegatecall target; NCC, Verichains, Dfns, CertiK, BlockSec and Safe's record give 0x9622... (used here).
